## Personality

Judson Parker is a jovial and smooth-spoken individual. He maintains a uniformly bland and good-natured demeanor, though he surprisingly possesses very few friends.

_Sources: [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P42](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0042)_

## History

Judson Parker consistently voted for [Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md) in political elections. When he planned to rent his fences out for advertisements, a committee from the Village [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvers) tried to persuade him to change his mind, but he initially refused. However, after [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) accidentally overheard him accepting a political bribe from [Jerry Corcoran](../character/jerry-corcoran.md), Judson hastily agreed to drop the fence advertisements to ensure her silence.

_Sources: [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P0](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0000), [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P15](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0015), [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P35](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0035), [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P50](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0050), [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P58](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0058), [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P61](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0061), +2 more_
